mails.subject: your members' branding, sorted 🎨
mails.body:
Hi Kanalhuset folks! 👋

Zoe from Pixel Pantry here. I've been following some of the startups that work out of your space and honestly, a lot of them could use a fresh logo or a cleaner pitch deck 😅

We're a small design studio, flat price of 600 EUR for a brand starter kit, ready in a week. Would you be up for mentioning us to your members? We'd happily give you a cut for every referral 💸

Let me know and I'll send some samples!

Zoe ✨
mails.justification: Cold outreach from a design studio the space never contacted, offering a referral cut for promoting its services.

mails.subject: Re: Gæsteindlæg på Kanalhuset
mails.body:
Hej igen,

> Vi skriver et gæsteindlæg til jeres blog, og I får gratis omtale.

Jeg følger op på min mail fra sidste uge, for jeg har ikke hørt fra jer. Vi har et færdigt indlæg om fleksible kontormiljøer, som vi gerne vil have på jeres side med to links til vores kunders hjemmesider. Hvis I ikke har tid til at skrive selv, kan vi lægge det ind for 1.200 kr.

Mvh
Frederik Skov
Linkværk
mails.justification: The 'Re:' and 'hear from you' wording suggest a thread, but the space never answered; it is a paid backlink placement offer from a stranger.

mails.subject: Din faktura er forfalden
mails.body:
Hej,

Vi kan ikke trække betalingen for dit Kanalhuset-medlemskab. Opdater dit kort inden i morgen for at undgå lukning af adgangskort: https://kanalhuset-mitkort.example/opdater

Mvh
Kanalhuset Betaling

mails.subject: Estate matter concerning Mr. Henrik Kanal, deceased
mails.body:
Good day,

Sorry for the typos, writing this from my phone while travelling. My name is Victor Lindqvist, I am a solicitor handling the estate of the late Mr. Henrik Kanal, who passed away without any family. He ran a small company in Copenhagen and his records show a connection to a business address matching your space, Kanalhuset.

The estate holds 4.7 million EUR in a dormant account, and under local law the funds will go to the state unless a beneficiary is named by the end of this year. I have reviewed your organisation and believe your community could be named as a beneficiary, which would allow the money to be used for the benefit of your members.

This is entirely legal and confidential. I only need your help to present the claim: I would ask for a small processing fee of 1,800 EUR, which will be deducted from your share afterwards, and a copy of the director's ID and the company bank details.

Time is very short, so please reply by Friday. I can arrange a video meeting if you doubt me, but I must tell you the matter is delicate and I would ask you not to discuss it with others.

Thank you in advance and God bless.

Victor Lindqvist
Solicitor, Aurum Estate Chambers
Sent from my iPhone
mails.justification: A classic inheritance scam with an advance fee and a request for bank details, using a made-up link to the space's address.

mails.from: Secrétariat général, Forum des Entreprises du Nord <secretariat@forum-entreprises-nord.example>
mails.subject: Convention annuelle du Forum, inscriptions ouvertes
mails.body:
Madame, Monsieur,

Le Forum des Entreprises du Nord a l'honneur de vous convier à sa convention annuelle, qui se tiendra le 19 novembre à Copenhague. Le programme comprend des conférences sur l'innovation, des ateliers et un dîner de gala.

Les tarifs d'inscription sont de 290 € par participant, et de 750 € pour une table de trois personnes. Les organisations de votre secteur peuvent également réserver un stand d'exposition.

Le programme complet et les modalités d'inscription sont disponibles sur https://forum-entreprises-nord.example/convention.

Veuillez agréer, Madame, Monsieur, l'expression de notre considération distinguée.

Le Secrétariat général
mails.justification: A formal mass invitation to a paid conference, sent to the space without any subscription or prior contact.

mails.subject: Dev roles, open now

mails.subject: Outsourced bookkeeping for Kanalhuset, 20 percent less
mails.body:
Dear Kanalhuset team,

My name is Rebecca Haldane and I lead partnerships at QuantifyOps, a finance operations provider working with coworking and flexible office operators across Europe.

We understand that a space of your type typically manages dozens of monthly memberships, day passes, meeting room bookings and event rentals, each with different VAT treatment. Reconciling these by hand takes time that would be better spent on your community.

Our service covers:

- Automated invoicing for memberships and day passes
- Reconciliation of card, bank transfer and booking-platform payments
- Monthly VAT reporting and year-end preparation
- A dedicated accountant reachable during Danish working hours

Pricing starts at 1,150 EUR per month for up to 100 active members, with a one-off onboarding fee of 900 EUR. Right now we are waiving the onboarding fee for operators who sign before 31 October. Our existing clients report saving an average of 14 hours a month.

I would be pleased to arrange a 30-minute call with one of our senior accountants, or to share anonymised examples of reports we produce for similar spaces. We can also prepare a tailored quote after a brief look at your current setup.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,
Rebecca Haldane
Head of Partnerships, QuantifyOps
https://quantifyops.example
mails.justification: Cold sales outreach for outsourced bookkeeping, tailored to coworking operations but sent by a vendor the space never contacted.

mails.subject: loved your community page 🙌
mails.body:
Hey team! 😊

Theo here from Summitlinks. I read through the Kanalhuset community page and loved it, especially how you highlight member stories. We work with sites like yours to get more traffic and I'd love to swap links or pay for a mention on one of your pages (we pay 150 EUR per link, no strings).

If that's interesting just send me the page you'd like to use 🚀

Cheers,
Theo
mails.justification: A paid link-placement offer from a stranger who flatters the space's page without any real relationship.

mails.subject: Re: Facture 2026-1137 – Kanalhuset
mails.body:
Bonjour,

> Veuillez trouver ci-joint la facture n° 2026-1137 pour la location de salle du mois de septembre.

Suite à notre précédent message, nous n'avons toujours pas reçu votre paiement. Le montant dû est de 1 380 € et il est exigible depuis le 30 septembre. Sans règlement sous 48 heures, des pénalités de retard de 10 % seront appliquées et le dossier sera transmis à notre service de recouvrement.

Pour consulter la facture et régler en ligne, connectez-vous avec l'adresse e-mail de votre compte Kanalhuset sur :
https://kanalhuset-factures.example/facture/2026-1137

Si vous avez déjà réglé cette facture, merci de ne pas tenir compte de ce rappel. Dans le cas contraire, nous vous remercions de régler au plus vite pour éviter toute procédure.

Cordialement,
Mathilde Aubry
Service comptabilité clients
mails.justification: A fake payment reminder in an invented 'Re:' thread, from a lookalike domain, for a room rental invoice the space never received, with a login link as the trap.
